about.name: Coach Mike Oneill
about.title: DC
about.bio:
Coach Mike Oneill is a proven 3 specialist with 12 years of coaching experience at Free Agent. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Oneill develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Oneill's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: Free Agent's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: 3 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 3 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Linebacker & Secondary Development
services.description: Position-specific coaching for front-seven and DB players — gap control, coverage technique, communication, and tackling.
